summary.text: Fred Meyer is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 41. His committee assignments are Agriculture, Business and Labor, and Government, Military and Veterans Affairs.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Meyer was born October 27, 1951, in West Point and graduated from West Point High School in 1970.
He attended the University of Nebraska-Lincoln, graduating in 1974.
His biography lists his occupation as farmer and rancher, with past work as a teacher and banker, and past service on the St. Paul Board of Education and the Nebraska State Board of Education.
It lists him as married to Kay Christensen since June 5, 1976, with three children.
